easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Foods.
description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Bag End Banquet and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Bag End Banquet and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Bag End Banquet and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
